changes.summary: Added version classification (classify_project_version), deterministic schema migrations (migrate_project), crash-safe recovery (recover_project), integrity auditing (audit_project_integrity), strict JSON parse bounds (parse_manifest_bytes with duplicate-key rejection, nonfinite float rejection, nesting depth bounds), and path traversal/symlink escape hardening.

Added dedicated adversarial and fault-injection test suite covering all 30 scenarios from prompt Part J (migration, recovery idempotency, interrupted writes, corrupted manifests, blob tampering, path traversal, symlink escapes, resource bounds, approval preservation/invalidation, and package compatibility).
